title: Remove or use dead code in core-traits, db, and query-algebrizer
description: Dead code warnings: method 'with' in core-traits/value_type_set.rs, methods 'set'/'get' in db/src/cache.rs, fields 'default_source'/'has_aggregates' in query-algebrizer/src/lib.rs. Either remove or add #[allow(dead_code)] with explanation.

title: Fix lifetime elision warnings across codebase
description: 22 warnings about lifetime syntax: 13 'eliding lifetime named elsewhere', 9 'hiding lifetime elided elsewhere', 3 'hiding lifetime named elsewhere'. Run cargo fix suggestions or manually add explicit lifetime annotations.

title: Replace deprecated time::Instant with std::time::Instant
description: 9 warnings about deprecated time::Instant. Import std::time::Instant and time::ext::InstantExt instead.

title: Add edition = 2021 to 19 sub-crate Cargo.toml files
Fix deprecated itertools and indexmap method calls
description: Replace group_by() with chunk_by() in itertools. Replace remove() with swap_remove() or shift_remove() in indexmap.

title: Address non-local impl warnings from failure_derive macro
description: 18 warnings about non-local impl from #[derive(Fail)]. Options: upgrade failure crate, migrate to thiserror/anyhow, or suppress warnings. Affects all *-traits crates.
